name: print-social-digital-payments-posters-with-glowing-spheres-and-grid-lines
title: Four digital-payments posters with glowing orange and violet spheres, sunset gradient and hairline grid
whatItIs: Four portrait posters: black with stacked orange glowing spheres and 'Payments wait. Digital money moves', white 'Market Notes from 2030' with only hairline grid lines, white 'Digital Payments Simplified' with an orange-pink-violet gradient rising from the bottom, and black with two huge violet spheres behind 'Digital Payments?'.
whatItMeans: Sleek and future-facing; soft glowing orbs make money feel fluid and light.
techniques: Use glowing spheres as abstract hero forms.
Show a faint hairline grid as structure.
Fade a sunset gradient up from the bottom edge.
Alternate black and white posters in a set.

vocabulary.definition: Very thin structural lines left visible.
